methodology.grouping_note: Raw ATU IDs mapped to 14 scholarly subdivisions following Uther (2004). Raw IDs (160 classes, ~8 examples each) gave ~25% CV accuracy; 7-class grouping was too coarse for narrative analysis. 14-class achieves ~70% CV accuracy on 1484 examples.
methodology.western_baseline: 5-fold cross-validated: each Western tale held out exactly once. No confidence score is ever measured on a tale the model was trained on.
methodology.asian_inference: Final model trained on all 1484 Western tales. Asian tales have no overlap with training data by construction.

indistribution_eval.note: 20% held-out test set, independent of CV confidence step

mahalanobis.note: Western = CV held-out per-fold; Asian = final model trained on all Western
